## Installation

Install the skill from the repository with one of the supported package runners:

```bash
npx skills add sinxy-sai/software-diagrams
bunx skills add sinxy-sai/software-diagrams
pnpm dlx skills add sinxy-sai/software-diagrams
```

## Included artifact

This release includes the `software-diagrams-<tag>-skill.tar.gz` skill package. It contains the provider-neutral `SKILL.md`, host entrypoints, references, and license. The full source tree and examples remain available from the GitHub tag archive.
